facts.hook: How the library accepts allocator hooks: the API, its signatures, and whether it supports aligned allocation.
facts.install_constraint: When the hooks must be installed (for example 'before any other call into the library').
facts.query: How glue can read back the installed hooks, if the library allows it.
facts.pre_install_check: How glue can tell nothing was allocated before the hooks were installed, if the library allows it.

rules.text: Every library's allocator hooks are installed, in the memory phase, before the library allocates anything.
Each library's installed hooks are the facade's, and the facade observes allocations from that library during a smoke run.
Memory allocated by one module is freed by the same allocator; across DLL or hot-reload boundaries the hooks are installed per module.
